mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses short-term discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market immediately prices in accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over three months signals labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as corporate earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Weak labor market growth (PAYEMS growth < 0.2% monthly) combined with declining housing starts (HOUST < 1100 thousand units) signals broad economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth < 0.2% and HOUST < 1100, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During sustained monetary tightening (FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising for 3 months), S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days as higher borrowing costs pressure corporate earnings and equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during FEDFUNDS > 0.5% and rising for 3 months, or tightening regime Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO > 104.0) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 104.0, or Rank IC < 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1100 thousand units signals weak consumer demand for housing, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as retail sales and corporate profitability expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 1100, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) combined with weak housing starts (HOUST < 1100 thousand units) signals stagflationary risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as real growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 2.5% and HOUST < 1100, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong economic growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%) generates positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in sustained corporate earnings expansion and consumer spending momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% (quarterly), or growth regime Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
